#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify actual AST-success traces against literal bounded business fixtures.

This postprocess reads only retained evidence and the owned four tiny fixtures.
It starts no product child, changes no gold, and never modifies original output.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('<evidence>')


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    out = parser.parse_args().output
    assert out.parent == ROOT and out.name == 'r07b-qualified-corrected'
    summary_bytes = (out / 'summary.json').read_bytes()
    summary = json.loads(summary_bytes)
    assert summary['stage'] == 'r07b' and summary['completed'] and summary['all_passed']
    assert summary['qualified_leaf_commands'] == summary['actual_leaf_commands'] == 126
    commands = json.loads((out / 'commands.json').read_bytes())['commands']
    by_label = {c['label']: c for c in commands if c['name'] == 'boundary'}
    cases = [str(n) + '-' + mode for n in [499, 500, 501] for mode in ['text', 'json', 'verbose']]
    cases += ['501-selected-syntax-skip']
    assert set(by_label) == set(cases) | {'frozen-complete-oracle'}
    checks = []
    inputs = []
    for case in ['499', '500', '501', '501-mixed']:
        count = 501 if case == '501-mixed' else int(case)
        base = out / 'boundaries' / case
        files = sorted(base.iterdir())
        expected_paths = [f'p-{n:03}.py' for n in range(count)]
        assert [p.name for p in files] == expected_paths
        rows = []
        for path in files:
            expected = b'def broken(:\n' if case == '501-mixed' and path.name == 'p-000.py' else b'import math\n'
            body = path.read_bytes()
            assert body == expected and not path.is_symlink()
            rows.append({'path': path.name, 'byte_count': len(body), 'original_bytes_sha256': sha(body)})
        inputs.append({'case': case, 'independent_candidate_count': count, 'files': rows})
    for label in cases:
        mixed = label == '501-selected-syntax-skip'
        count = 501 if mixed else int(label.split('-')[0])
        selected = [f'p-{n:03}.py' for n in range(min(count, 500))]
        successful = [p for p in selected if not (mixed and p == 'p-000.py')]
        command = by_label[label]
        assert command['actual_exit'] == command['expected_exit'] == 0
        monitor_path = out / 'monitors' / ('boundary-' + label + '.json')
        monitor_bytes = monitor_path.read_bytes()
        monitor = json.loads(monitor_bytes)
        for key, expected in [('attempted_target_parse_paths', selected), ('successful_target_parse_paths', successful)]:
            actual = monitor[key]
            checks.append({'label': label, 'field': key, 'actual': actual, 'expected': expected, 'equal': actual == expected, 'monitor_bytes_sha256': sha(monitor_bytes)})
        stderr = (out / 'raw' / ('boundary-' + label + '.stderr')).read_bytes()
        stdout = (out / 'raw' / ('boundary-' + label + '.stdout')).read_bytes()
        assert sha(stderr) == command['stderr_sha256'] and stderr.decode('utf-8') == command['stderr']
        assert sha(stdout) == command['stdout_sha256'] and stdout.decode('utf-8') == command['stdout']
        expected_stderr = b''
        if count == 501:
            expected_stderr = (
                b'scan: Python analysis incomplete: parsed 499 of 501 candidate files; selected 500 (limit 500), omitted 1. 1 selected files were not parsed. Missing signals may be in unanalysed files.\n'
                if mixed else
                b'scan: Python analysis incomplete: parsed 500 of 501 candidate files; selected 500 (limit 500), omitted 1. Missing signals may be in unanalysed files.\n'
            )
        checks.append({'label': label, 'field': 'source-backed-literal-stderr', 'actual': stderr.decode('utf-8'), 'expected': expected_stderr.decode('utf-8'), 'equal': stderr == expected_stderr, 'actual_original_bytes_sha256': sha(stderr), 'expected_literal_bytes_sha256': sha(expected_stderr)})
    assert len(checks) == 30 and all(c['equal'] for c in checks)
    report = {'schema_version': 1, 'stage': 'r07b', 'all_passed': True, 'product_commands_executed': 0, 'additional_actual_leaf_commands': 0, 'scope': 'Pure evidence qualification of the ten already completed bounded current CLI children. No product rerun or current-output gold promotion.', 'independent_expectation': 'Four owned literal fixture trees: import math in every valid p-NNN.py; only mixed p-000.py is invalid syntax. Select sorted first500, then count actual successful ast.parse-return paths; never infer parsed from selected.', 'source_contract': {'accepted_patch_sha256': '8df82d2da2745615895ae06881312984cdaa65ca95c65b388379284810da9542', 'default_trigger': 'candidate greater than active file limit only'}, 'original_qualified_summary_sha256': sha(summary_bytes), 'source_input_trees': inputs, 'comparison_count': 30, 'checks': checks}
    path = out / 'boundary-AST-source-qualification.json'
    assert not path.exists()
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'all_passed': True, 'additional_product_children': 0, 'independent_comparisons': 30, 'report_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes())}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
